manifest.description: The machine-readable commander's intent: what to optimize, in what priority, under what regime, with what dollar-grounded weights, and what is a hard floor. Robotaxi-first, sector-agnostic objective structure, multi-OEM expressed in Tier 3 constraints.

numeraire.decision: lexicographic — objectives are ordered by priority, never summed into a single dollar scale
numeraire.reason: R-10: no robotaxi operator has published a dollar value for a late minute or an unready vehicle. A weight would be a price on lateness nobody agreed to. Readiness is therefore a floor, not a coefficient.

bess_peak_shave.dollar_value_detail: 500 kWh BESS shaving 200 kW saves $48-60k/yr at $20-25/kW demand rates (mgrid.org / NREL ATB)
bess_peak_shave.label: BESS peak shaving
bess_peak_shave.metric: site_peak_kw (the instantaneous peak the demand charge bills)
bess_peak_shave.solver_wiring: implemented (build_and_solve objective_mode=min_peak; policies/forward.py dispatch_storage aims the battery at the billed peak)

deadhead.dollar_value_detail: the empty-mile ratio is sourced (Waymo ~44% of CA miles empty, MIT/CPUC) but the $/deadhead-mile depends on unpublished operator $/mile (R-11 NOT FOUND ledger)
deadhead.label: Deadhead / repositioning (empty moves)
deadhead.metric: empty_moves (inter-point moves an asset makes without a service need)

provenance.source_name: Waymo empty miles, MIT Transport Findings (CPUC data)

deadhead.solver_wiring: partial (the churn term in build_and_solve prices inter-point moves; deadhead at the fleet level is not yet a solver term)

degradation.dollar_value_detail: capping charge at 50% vs 100% SoC extends EV battery lifetime 44-130% (Wikner & Thiringer 2018); coordinated scheduling+charging cuts degradation cost 7.45% (JRSE/IEEE 2024)
degradation.label: Battery degradation (thermal / SoC park / cold-charge)
degradation.solver_wiring: partial (chemistry cap max_daily_soc_pct is enforced as data; cold-start and SoC-park are model terms in wear/degradation.py, not yet solver objectives)

dwell.dollar_value_detail: dwell has no tariff term; its cost is indirect (occupies a stall, blocks throughput). Reference range sourced (38-52 min full cycle), the $ cost is not
dwell.label: Dwell / turnaround time
dwell.metric: dwell_minutes (time an asset occupies a resource without productive work)
dwell.solver_wiring: implemented (build_and_solve objective_mode=min_flow; same lever as throughput, deduped in intent/solve.py)

energy_cost.dollar_value_detail: demand charge $21.40/kW first 1,000 kW (NES GSA-3); NES EVC flat 21.773 c/kWh no TOU differential
energy_cost.label: Energy cost (demand charge + time-of-use energy)

provenance.source_name: R-5 demand-charge structures / R-6 TOU windows

energy_cost.solver_wiring: implemented (build_and_solve objective_mode=min_peak is the demand-charge lever; sites/tariff.py bills the real curve)

readiness.dollar_value_detail: no published $/minute for robotaxi lateness; nearest regime (NYCT paratransit $10 per pickup >15min late) is transit, not robotaxi, and non-transferable (R-10)
readiness.label: Fleet readiness / availability
readiness.metric: tardy_minutes (minutes a vehicle is late past its required-ready time)
readiness.solver_wiring: implemented (build_and_solve objective_mode=min_tardy is the readiness floor)

risk_hedge.dollar_value_detail: protecting against 10% energy-demand deviation adds <0.1% to total electricity cost (ETH Zurich 2026) — cheap enough to buy by default
risk_hedge.label: Risk / uncertainty hedge

provenance.source_name: Optimal EV depot charging: cost savings, grid limits, robustness (ETH Zurich)

risk_hedge.solver_wiring: not implemented (the forecast's uncertainty band is the input; the solver does not yet reserve capacity against it)

service_completion.dollar_value_detail: must-by windows are obligations, not prices; SLA penalties are unpublished (R-10 Q4: no AV depot penalty schedule is public)
service_completion.label: Service completion (manifests done by must-by)
service_completion.solver_wiring: partial (the shield enforces must-by as a hard deadline; the agentic ordering of deferrable service within the window is not yet a solver term)

staff.dollar_value_detail: up to 75% productivity gain and ~$1.7M/yr savings per 50-bay depot from robotic charging (Rocsys 2026); manual depot ~1:12-1:14 humans:vehicles
staff.label: Staff utilization
staff.solver_wiring: not implemented (staff is not a solver resource yet; it is a KPI and a packing objective in the robotaxi catalog)

staging.dollar_value_detail: staging cost is site-footprint and congestion; no published $ figure exists
staging.label: Staging efficiency
staging.metric: staging_footprint (assets buffered between service-complete and dispatch)

provenance.source_name: R-10 fleet-uptime SLA terms (staging is a zoning/land-use condition, not a priced term)

staging.solver_wiring: not implemented (staging is a consequence of schedule, not yet a term)

throughput.dollar_value_detail: no published $/cycle; value is operational (a cycled vehicle is a revenue-ready vehicle), not a direct tariff term
throughput.label: Throughput / vehicle cycles
throughput.solver_wiring: implemented (build_and_solve objective_mode=min_flow is the throughput/dwell lever — minimize the fleet's sum of finish times, the dual of vehicles cycled)

regimes.label: Dispatch rush (morning/evening peaks)
regimes.rationale: get vehicles out the gate on time; minimize empty repositioning; energy cost yields

regimes.label: Overnight soak
regimes.rationale: vehicles return for full charge, cleaning, inspection, service; non-urgent work queues here; cheap off-peak energy; park at SoC that minimizes calendar fade (wraps midnight: 20:00 through 04:59)

regimes.label: Grid peak (demand-charge window)
regimes.rationale: the demand charge is set by one 15-min interval; aim the battery at it; protect the peak with the robustness band

regimes.label: Demand surge
regimes.rationale: serve the surge; every revenue-ready vehicle counts; minimize empty miles and staging backlog

regimes.label: Weather event (grounding risk)
regimes.rationale: protect the fleet; prioritize safe service completion; battery thermal care matters more in extreme conditions

regimes.label: Steady state (default)
regimes.rationale: the default ordering: readiness floor, then obligations, then cost, then the rest

tier3_constraints.note: Tier 3 is NOT weighted and does NOT live in this artifact. It is the 52-rule deterministic shield plus the legal parameters: power caps, double-booking exclusion, incompatible asset/point pairing, state-machine validity, chemistry caps (max_daily_soc_pct), per-OEM charge curves, sensor-suite calibration cadences. This artifact points at it and never duplicates it.
